instruction_reference: Current chat: recommended EN/FR fallback-content review process
approval_scope: The review process and recommended cadence for the private demo fallback publication. This records no approval of an actual content artifact.

process.action: Verify contact channels, operating hours, geographic coverage, eligibility and limitations against current authoritative Canadian service-operator information; retain English/French source evidence.

Review the exact English and French wording for equivalent meaning, clarity, appropriate Canadian French and accurate service/status distinctions. One suitably qualified bilingual reviewer may cover content and language; add translation expertise where needed. The publication reviewer must be distinct from the publishing operator.
Test keyboard navigation, screen-reader output, contrast, zoom and mobile layout; resolve findings in both languages before approving the artifact.

Bind the exact ordered EN/FR artifact digest, source-verification evidence, actual independent reviewer identity, verification date and review-due date to the signed review record before publication. Any changed published wording requires review of the changed exact artifact.

cadence.status: Project policy; no statutory review interval is asserted.

publication_conditions: Prepare the actual bilingual information card and name its content owner and independent reviewer.
Complete attributable factual, language and accessibility review of the exact artifact.
Validate the review record and signature with the actual configured reviewer authority; synthetic fixture signatures do not establish human approval.
Publish only a currently valid reviewed artifact; retain explicit unavailable status if no such artifact exists.
